notes: T1-T2 repeated unprotected R&D runs (8 runs) re-accessing the same top card, and T4 facechecked N-Pot on Server 2 with 3 credits; T8-T10 clicked for credits up to 20 holding 5 cards and never contested Server 2, where Freedom of Information (T8), Post-Truth Dividend (T9) and the winning Freedom of Information (installed T10, scored T11) were advanced.

Quick scores of Project Yagi-Uda (T3) and Sericulture Expansion (T4) were good, but they left the corp at 0-3 credits until T10, so it could never rez R&D ice while the runner ran R&D 3-4 times a turn; Public Health Portal sat unrezzed, and the T13-T14 credit clicks at 12-13 credits were slow before Hybrid Release (T15) and Yagi-Uda (T17) closed the game.

Never installed a single card all game: from T4 to T17 it only clicked for credits (reaching 63) with 5 cards held, facechecked Afshar (T2), Descent (T6) and Tree Line (T18) with no breakers, and let Above the Law (T7), Transport Monopoly (T11-12) and Above the Law (T18-19) be scored from remotes unopposed.

Clean, efficient Server 2 scoring of Megaprix Qualifier (T4, T6 with Seamless Launch), Project Ingatan (T7) and Méliès City Luxury Line (T9), with Ansel 1.0 rezzed well on HQ; the only blemish is Otto Campaign installed naked in Server 3 on T6 and trashed for 2.

Won through HQ and R&D pressure, but repeated HQ runs re-accessed the same cards (Game Over, Loot Box, Ping) on T10-T14; Window of Opportunity on T3 was wasted derezzing a harmless Congratulations! and walking back into Behold! tags; Server 2 was ignored on T8 before Tomorrow's Headline was scored on T9, and Carmen was only installed for Starlit Knight on T13.

Scoring Project Ingatan (T3) and Superconducting Hub (T4) left it at 0-1 credits, so Architect Deployment Test, which Drafter installed into Server 1 behind unrezzable ice, was stolen on T4; Méliès City Luxury Line was left at 2 advancements behind Hagen and Wave and stolen on T6, and Otto Campaign went naked into Server 3 on T7 and was trashed.

Never reinstalled Telework Contract or any rig after F2P bounced it on T1, and kept running through Vasilisa and F2P with tags floating, which the corp turned into two Backroom Machinations points (T4, T5); it overdrew into discards on T1, T3, T5 and T7, but R&D volume against a passive corp stole Artificial Cryptocrash, Next Big Thing and Kingmaking.

T1-T2 made 8 runs on an open HQ re-seeing Secure and Protect and Akhet while the naked-ish Server 1 agenda (Above the Law, scored T2) went unchecked; from T5 to T13 it only clicked for credits (to 46) with Boi-tatá installed, never contesting Above the Law (T11-12) or Divested Trust (T13-14) in Server 1.

Neurospike was played on T3 for no effect; Lotus Haze sat in HQ behind Anemone and was stolen on T4 and T8, Hybrid Release went into Server 3 on T5 with only 3 credits and was stolen, and See How They Run was installed on T9 with 1 credit and stolen at once while the economy sat at 0-2 credits from T6.

R&D had no ice on T1-T2 (Hybrid Release stolen on T1); splitting advances between Server 1 and Server 2 on T5 and spending down to 0 credits on T6 and T8 meant the R&D ice was never rezzed, so the runner walked in and stole See How They Run, Longevity Serum, Hybrid Release and the winning Lotus Haze.

Slow start: on T3-T6 it clicked for credits at 12-14 credits and spent clicks advancing Vladisibirsk City Grid in the R&D root and icing an empty Server 1, with the first agenda only installed on T7; after that, Tomorrow's Headline twice, Post-Truth Dividend and Next Big Thing were scored cleanly from Server 3 against a passive runner.

Sensible plan: an early HQ steal of Above the Law, then steady R&D runs using Banner against Akhet (Transport Monopoly T7, Divested Trust T13) and a closing HQ steal of SDS Drone Deployment on T14; the economy was thin and paying 13 credits to Measured Response on T12 left it broke for a turn.

From T2 to T7 it drew and clicked for credits at 10-17 credits while holding 5-6 cards and discarding every turn, with no remote until T8 (Post-Truth Dividend and Tomorrow's Headline were stolen from HQ on T8 and T11); T5 spent all 3 clicks and 6 credits trashing Stoneship Chart Room; afterwards it scored Embedded Reporting and Next Big Thing twice cleanly.

After Saisentan shredded the grip on T5, it clicked for credits from T8 to T12 (reaching 33) and never contested Server 2, where Fujii Asset Retrieval (T13), Regenesis (T14) and the winning Longevity Serum (T15-16) were scored; on T14-T15 it made 8 HQ runs re-accessing Hansei Review and Mindscaping instead of hitting Server 2.

Strong, focused play: an R&D steal of Fujii Asset Retrieval (T3), a Revolver setup to break Saisentan, then Project Yagi-Uda from R&D (T9) and HQ (T10); the one risk was running the unrezzed Server 3 against Jinteki on T4 with a 2-card grip and eating Urtica Cipher's 2 net damage.

Left R&D with no ice on T1-T2 while the runner stole two Méliès City Luxury Line from it, spending T2 on Petty Cash and two credit clicks instead; the single Wave placed on R&D on T3 does not end the run, so Architect Deployment Test was stolen on T4 right after Project Ingatan was scored.

Good R&D steal of SDS Drone Deployment with Banner on T4, but T5-T10 went into installing economy pieces while Transport Monopoly (T6-7) and Divested Trust (T8-9) were scored unopposed from Server 1; the T11-T18 HQ assault won the game but included many repeat accesses of Government Subsidy and Wall to Wall.

Scored nothing in 14 turns: after the Urtica Cipher trap it mostly clicked for credits and discarded at end of turn (T3, T5, T6, T10, T13, T14), and never installed an agenda even after Server 2 had 3 ice (T11), so Flower Sermon (T8), Project Yagi-Uda (T9), Sericulture Expansion and Fujii Asset Retrieval (T14) were all stolen from HQ behind a single Ivik.

Wave and Ansel 1.0 on HQ blanked the runner and Otto Campaign built a huge bank, and it scored Project Ingatan twice, Architect Deployment Test and Megaprix Qualifier by T10; the oddity is hoarding 40-60 unused credits and drawing slowly (T5) instead of converting the bank into faster scoring.

Never installed a breaker; it clicked for credits nearly every turn (54 by T22) and facechecked Klevetnik (T10) and Capacitor (T13) with nothing; after two R&D steals on T16 put it at 3 points (then 5 with Kingmaking on T21), it never ran R&D again or contested Server 3 (Oracle Thinktank, T19) or Server 4, where Artificial Cryptocrash sat from T13 until the winning score on T23.
